description: Design forward and reverse PCR primers flanking a target region with Primer3's pair search (verified against primer3-py design_primers): per-primer limits (length, GC%, Primer3-default SantaLucia Tm, poly-X, dinucleotide repeat) plus, by default, Primer3's thermodynamic structure screen (ntthal self-dimer, 3' self-dimer, hairpin Tm <= 47 °C); pairs need a product size in product_size_range (default 100-300 bp), |ΔTm| <= max_tm_difference (default 5 °C) and pair hetero-dimer / 3' hetero-dimer Tm <= 47 °C; returns the lowest Primer3 pair penalty pair, its product Tm and complementarity, an optional internal hybridization oligo and up to num_return ranked pairs. With parameters.StructureScreen = Primer3Alignment the screen is Primer3's alignment mode (PRIMER_THERMODYNAMIC_OLIGO_ALIGNMENT=0: dpal self_any/self_end <= 8/3, pair compl_any/compl_end <= pair_max_compl_any/pair_max_compl_end 8/3) and complAny/complEnd are reported.

target_end.description: 0-based exclusive end of target region (with the default inside_penalty/outside_penalty primers never overlap [target_start, target_end)).

parameters.description: Optional primer design parameters (lengths, GC%, Tm, repeats, GC-clamp/3' stability checks, structure screen). Defaults are used if null.

product_size_range.description: PRIMER_PRODUCT_SIZE_RANGE in Primer3 syntax, e.g. "100-300" or "150-250 100-400" (ranges in order of preference; default 100-300).

max_tm_difference.description: PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_DIFF_TM: maximum |Tm_forward - Tm_reverse| in °C (default 5; Primer3's own default is 100).

num_return.description: PRIMER_NUM_RETURN: number of ranked pairs listed in 'pairs' (default 1).

pick_internal_oligo.description: PRIMER_PICK_INTERNAL_OLIGO: also pick an internal hybridization oligo between the primers (Primer3 PRIMER_INTERNAL_* defaults; default false).

pair_max_compl_any.description: PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_COMPL_ANY: maximum Primer3 alignment-mode pair compl_any (used only with parameters.StructureScreen = Primer3Alignment; default 8).

pair_max_compl_end.description: PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_COMPL_END: maximum Primer3 alignment-mode pair compl_end (used only with parameters.StructureScreen = Primer3Alignment; default 3).

salt_monovalent.description: PRIMER_SALT_MONOVALENT: monovalent cation concentration in mM (> 0) for primer Tm, ntthal structure / pair complementarity and product Tm (default 50).

salt_divalent.description: PRIMER_SALT_DIVALENT: Mg2+ concentration in mM (>= 0; default 1.5).

dntp_conc.description: PRIMER_DNTP_CONC: dNTP concentration in mM (>= 0; default 0.6).

dna_conc.description: PRIMER_DNA_CONC: primer concentration in nM (> 0; default 50).

opt_gc_percent.description: PRIMER_OPT_GC_PERCENT: GC optimum of the primer GC penalty terms (default undefined, as in Primer3's code; required when wt_gc_percent_gt/lt != 0 - otherwise Primer3's error 'Primer GC content is part of objective function while optimum gc_content is not defined').

wt_gc_percent_gt.description: PRIMER_WT_GC_PERCENT_GT: penalty weight for GC% above opt_gc_percent (default 0).

wt_gc_percent_lt.description: PRIMER_WT_GC_PERCENT_LT: penalty weight for GC% below opt_gc_percent (default 0).

internal_salt_monovalent.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_SALT_MONOVALENT for the internal oligo, mM (> 0; default 50).

internal_salt_divalent.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_SALT_DIVALENT for the internal oligo, mM (>= 0; default 0).

internal_dntp_conc.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_DNTP_CONC for the internal oligo, mM (>= 0; default 0).

internal_dna_conc.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_DNA_CONC for the internal oligo, nM (> 0; default 50).

internal_opt_gc_percent.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_OPT_GC_PERCENT: GC optimum of the internal-oligo GC penalty terms (default undefined; required when internal_wt_gc_percent_gt/lt != 0, even without pick_internal_oligo - Primer3 'Hyb probe GC content is part of objective function while optimum gc_content is not defined').

gc_clamp.description: PRIMER_GC_CLAMP: number of consecutive G/C required at each primer's 3' end (default 0; must be <= the minimum primer length).

max_end_gc.description: PRIMER_MAX_END_GC: maximum G/C among the five 3'-most bases of each primer (0-5; default 5 = no limit).

max_end_stability.description: PRIMER_MAX_END_STABILITY: maximum 3' end stability (Primer3 end_stability = -dG of the 3' pentamer, kcal/mol, >= 0; default 100 = no limit).

min_left_three_prime_distance.description: PRIMER_MIN_LEFT_THREE_PRIME_DISTANCE: after a pair is selected, later pairs may not use a left primer whose 3' end is closer than this (0 = not the identical primer; default -1 = reuse allowed).

min_right_three_prime_distance.description: PRIMER_MIN_RIGHT_THREE_PRIME_DISTANCE: as min_left_three_prime_distance for right primers (default -1).

min_three_prime_distance.description: PRIMER_MIN_THREE_PRIME_DISTANCE: sets both the left and right minimum 3' distances (cannot be combined with min_left/right_three_prime_distance).

mispriming_library.description: PRIMER_MISPRIMING_LIBRARY as a name -> sequence object (primer3-py misprime_lib), e.g. {"Alu*2": "GGCCGGGCGCGG..."}; an optional '*weight' (0-100) after the name scales that entry; IUPAC codes allowed. Each primer is scored against every entry and its reverse complement (Primer3 dpal, 3'-anchored); reported as libraryMispriming/libraryMisprimingName per primer and pair.

max_library_mispriming.description: PRIMER_MAX_LIBRARY_MISPRIMING: maximum weighted library score of one primer (default 12).

pair_max_library_mispriming.description: PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_LIBRARY_MISPRIMING: maximum pair library score (integer part of left + right score for the same entry; default 24).

wt_library_mispriming.description: PRIMER_WT_LIBRARY_MISPRIMING: per-primer penalty weight of the library score (default 0; needs mispriming_library).

pair_wt_library_mispriming.description: PRIMER_PAIR_WT_LIBRARY_MISPRIMING: pair penalty weight of the pair library score (default 0; needs mispriming_library).

lib_ambiguity_codes_consensus.description: PRIMER_LIB_AMBIGUITY_CODES_CONSENSUS: false (Primer3 default 0) = IUPAC codes in the library never match; true = they match every base they represent (N matches anything).

internal_mishyb_library.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MISHYB_LIBRARY as a name -> sequence object (primer3-py mishyb_lib; same format as mispriming_library), used with pick_internal_oligo: each internal oligo is scored against every entry and its reverse complement (Primer3 dpal, unanchored local alignment); reported as internalOligo.libraryMishyb/libraryMishybName.

internal_max_library_mishyb.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_LIBRARY_MISHYB: maximum weighted library score of the internal oligo (default 12).

internal_wt_library_mishyb.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_LIBRARY_MISHYB: internal-oligo penalty weight of the library score (default 0; needs internal_mishyb_library).

thermodynamic_template_alignment.description: PRIMER_THERMODYNAMIC_TEMPLATE_ALIGNMENT: false (Primer3 default 0) = template mispriming is a dpal score (3'-anchored local alignment of the primer with the template outside its own site and with the opposite strand); true = the ntthal 3'-end (END1) Tm in °C (template <= 10000 nt). Uses the *_template_mispriming_th limits/weights.

max_template_mispriming.description: PRIMER_MAX_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING: maximum template mispriming score of one primer (alignment mode; default -100 = not checked); reported as templateMispriming per primer.

max_template_mispriming_th.description: PRIMER_MAX_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING_TH: maximum template mispriming Tm of one primer, °C (thermodynamic mode; default -100 = not checked).

pair_max_template_mispriming.description: PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING: maximum pair template mispriming score (max(left same-strand + right other-strand, left other-strand + right same-strand); alignment mode; default -100 = not checked).

pair_max_template_mispriming_th.description: PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING_TH: maximum pair template mispriming value (thermodynamic mode; default -100). As in Primer3 a pair fails when this is non-zero and exceeded, so with the default and a non-zero pair_wt_template_mispriming_th every pair fails; 0 = no limit.

wt_template_mispriming.description: PRIMER_WT_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING: per-primer penalty weight of the template mispriming score (alignment mode; default 0).

wt_template_mispriming_th.description: PRIMER_WT_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING_TH: per-primer penalty weight of the template mispriming Tm (thermodynamic mode, Primer3 temp_cutoff rule; default 0).

pair_wt_template_mispriming.description: PRIMER_PAIR_WT_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING: pair penalty weight of the pair template mispriming score (alignment mode; default 0).

pair_wt_template_mispriming_th.description: PRIMER_PAIR_WT_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING_TH: pair penalty weight of the pair template mispriming value (thermodynamic mode; default 0).

annealing_temp.description: PRIMER_ANNEALING_TEMP: annealing temperature in °C (<= 100; default -10 = off). When > 0 the fraction of each primer / internal oligo bound at this temperature is computed (Primer3 oligotm, SantaLucia 1998) and the bound limits / weights below apply; it is also the internal oligo's annealing temperature.

min_bound.description: PRIMER_MIN_BOUND: minimum fraction bound of a primer, % (default -10; only with annealing_temp > 0).

max_bound.description: PRIMER_MAX_BOUND: maximum fraction bound of a primer, % (default 110; only with annealing_temp > 0).

opt_bound.description: PRIMER_OPT_BOUND: optimum fraction bound of the bound penalty terms, % (default 97; must lie in [min_bound, max_bound]).

wt_bound_gt.description: PRIMER_WT_BOUND_GT: per-primer penalty weight of the fraction bound above opt_bound (default 0; only with annealing_temp > 0).

wt_bound_lt.description: PRIMER_WT_BOUND_LT: per-primer penalty weight of the fraction bound below opt_bound (default 0; only with annealing_temp > 0).

internal_min_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MIN_BOUND: minimum fraction bound of the internal oligo, % (default -10; only with annealing_temp > 0).

internal_max_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_BOUND: maximum fraction bound of the internal oligo, % (default 110; only with annealing_temp > 0).

internal_opt_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_OPT_BOUND: optimum fraction bound of the internal-oligo bound terms, % (default 97).

internal_wt_bound_gt.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_BOUND_GT: internal-oligo penalty weight of the fraction bound above internal_opt_bound (default 0).

internal_wt_bound_lt.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_BOUND_LT: internal-oligo penalty weight of the fraction bound below internal_opt_bound (default 0). As in Primer3 it applies even without annealing_temp, where the bound is Primer3's error value -999999.9999.

inside_penalty.description: PRIMER_INSIDE_PENALTY: penalty per base of a primer 3' end inside the target (default -1). Any value other than the defaults -1 / 0 of inside_penalty / outside_penalty lets primers overlap the target as long as their 3' end does not pass its far end; as in Primer3 the default -1 then makes inside positions negative, and a negative pair penalty is an error.

outside_penalty.description: PRIMER_OUTSIDE_PENALTY: penalty per base of distance between a primer 3' end and the target (default 0; see inside_penalty).

wt_pos_penalty.description: PRIMER_WT_POS_PENALTY: weight of the position penalty in the primer penalty (default 1).

sequence_quality.description: SEQUENCE_QUALITY: one integer base quality per template base (e.g. Phred scores; length = template length, values within [quality_range_min, quality_range_max]). Each primer / internal oligo then reports minSequenceQuality (its minimum base quality).

min_quality.description: PRIMER_MIN_QUALITY: minimum base quality of a primer (default 0; non-zero needs sequence_quality and must lie in the quality range).

min_end_quality.description: PRIMER_MIN_END_QUALITY: minimum base quality of a primer's five 3'-most bases (default 0; only with sequence_quality).

quality_range_max.description: PRIMER_QUALITY_RANGE_MAX: largest allowed sequence_quality value (default 100); the quality penalty is wt_seq_qual x (quality_range_max - min quality).

wt_seq_qual.description: PRIMER_WT_SEQ_QUAL: per-primer penalty weight of (quality_range_max - the primer's minimum base quality) (default 0; needs sequence_quality).

wt_end_qual.description: PRIMER_WT_END_QUAL: accepted for Primer3 compatibility; Primer3 2.3.1 never uses it in the penalty (no effect).

internal_min_quality.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MIN_QUALITY: minimum base quality of the internal oligo (default 0; non-zero needs sequence_quality).

internal_wt_seq_qual.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_SEQ_QUAL: internal-oligo penalty weight of (quality_range_max - its minimum base quality) (default 0; needs sequence_quality).

internal_wt_end_qual.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_END_QUAL: accepted for Primer3 compatibility; no effect (as in Primer3 2.3.1).

pair_wt_io_penalty.description: PRIMER_PAIR_WT_IO_PENALTY: pair penalty weight of the internal-oligo penalty (default 0; non-zero requires pick_internal_oligo, as in Primer3).

mask_template.description: PRIMER_MASK_TEMPLATE: mask the template with Primer3's k-mer masker (needs mask_kmers_11 and mask_kmers_16): primers whose 3' base is masked on their strand are rejected and each primer gets its predicted failure rate (reported as maskFailureRate; weight wt_mask_failure_rate). Default false.

mask_kmers_11.description: The masker's 11-mer genome counts as a k-mer -> count object (the content of PRIMER_MASK_KMERLIST_PATH/<prefix>_11.list, e.g. a GenomeTester4 glistmaker list); k-mers absent here and as reverse complement count as 1.

mask_kmers_16.description: The masker's 16-mer genome counts (content of <prefix>_16.list), as mask_kmers_11.

mask_failure_rate.description: PRIMER_MASK_FAILURE_RATE: template positions where a primer would end with a predicted failure rate above this are masked (default 0.1; 0 = none).

mask_5p_direction.description: PRIMER_MASK_5P_DIRECTION: bases masked from such a 3' end towards the primer 5' end, including it (default 1).

mask_3p_direction.description: PRIMER_MASK_3P_DIRECTION: bases masked beyond such a 3' end (default 0).

wt_mask_failure_rate.description: PRIMER_WT_MASK_FAILURE_RATE: per-primer penalty weight of the predicted failure rate (default 0; effective only with mask_template).

lowercase_masking.description: PRIMER_LOWERCASE_MASKING: reject primers and internal oligos whose 3'-terminal template base is lower case (a/c/g/t of the template as given; lower case elsewhere in an oligo is accepted). Default false; mask_template implies it.

forward.description: Best forward primer candidate (PRIMER_LEFT_0). Includes bound (PRIMER_LEFT_0_BOUND, annealing_temp > 0) and positionPenalty (PRIMER_LEFT_0_POSITION_PENALTY, non-default inside/outside penalty).

reverse.description: Best reverse primer candidate (PRIMER_RIGHT_0). Includes bound and positionPenalty (PRIMER_RIGHT_0_*).

isValid.description: True when a compatible pair was found.

internalOligo.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_0_* (sequence, start, length, tm, gcPercent, selfAnyTh, selfEndTh, hairpinTh, penalty) when pick_internal_oligo; bound (PRIMER_INTERNAL_0_BOUND) with annealing_temp > 0.

pairs.description: Ranked valid pairs (PRIMER_PAIR_k, k < num_return), each with forward, reverse, productSize, pairPenalty, productTm, complAnyTh, complEndTh, internalOligo; empty when no pair qualifies.

libraryMispriming.description: PRIMER_PAIR_0_LIBRARY_MISPRIMING: pair library mispriming score (with mispriming_library).

libraryMisprimingName.description: Library entry of the pair libraryMispriming score.

templateMispriming.description: PRIMER_PAIR_0_TEMPLATE_MISPRIMING[_TH]: pair template mispriming (when Primer3 computes it).

errors.message: Template cannot be null or empty
Target end must be within the template
Target start must be strictly less than target end
Optimum primer / internal oligo fraction binding lower than minimum or higher than maximum; Annealing temperature higher than 100 C (Primer3 _pr_data_control)
Negative primer-pair penalty (Primer3 obj_fn PR_ASSERT(sum >= 0.0)): negative per-primer position penalties
